description: Phenix ksdssp helix inventory of the ftm3 and SPAC750.05c AlphaFold models against hydropathy and the Phobius TM segments
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
P="/agent/jobs/21a3a723-58c5-4fca-8ed8-e8c861fa5e39/provenance/"
KD=dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,K=-3.9,
        M=1.9,F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
three={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H',
       'ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W',
       'TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
def read_af(p):
    seq={};pl={}
    for ln in open(p):
        if ln.startswith("ATOM") and ln[12:16].strip()=="CA":
            i=int(ln[22:26]);seq[i]=three.get(ln[17:20].strip(),"X");pl[i]=float(ln[60:66])
    return seq,pl
HEL={"P0CU06":[(2,18),(26,28),(38,61),(67,83),(85,91),(94,123),(135,137)],
     "Q9P3E6":[(2,22),(49,51),(76,78),(85,87),(90,120),(127,154),(158,189),(197,221),
               (224,235),(237,257),(262,291),(293,295),(298,313),(315,321),(325,341)]}
PTM={"P0CU06":[(38,59)],"Q9P3E6":[(95,116),(128,145),(177,193),(200,220),(232,250),(271,288),(300,322)]}
NAME={"P0CU06":"ftm3 (146 aa)","Q9P3E6":"SPAC750.05c / Q9P3E6 (344 aa)"}
h=pd.read_csv(P+"table7_alphafold_helix_inventory.csv")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,6.8))
for ax,acc in zip(axes,["P0CU06","Q9P3E6"]):
    seq,pl=read_af(P+f"AF-{acc}-F1.pdb"); n=max(seq); xs=np.arange(1,n+1)
    kd=np.array([np.mean([KD[seq[j]] for j in range(max(1,i-9),min(n,i+9)+1)]) for i in xs])
    ax.axhline(0,color="#999",lw=0.6); ax.axhline(1.6,color="#c0392b",ls=":",lw=1)
    ax.plot(xs,kd,color="#333",lw=1.1)
    for (a,b) in PTM[acc]: ax.axvspan(a,b,color="#e07b39",alpha=0.30)
    sub=h[h.acc==acc]
    for _,rw in sub.iterrows():
        a,b=map(int,rw.helix.split("-"))
        ax.plot([a,b],[-4.3,-4.3],lw=7,color=("#2e7d32" if rw.membrane_competent else "#9aa5ad"),solid_capstyle="butt")
        if rw.membrane_competent: ax.text((a+b)/2,-3.75,f"KD {rw.mean_KD:+.2f}",ha="center",fontsize=6.5,color="#2e7d32")
    ax.set_xlim(0,n+1); ax.set_ylim(-4.9,3.0); ax.set_ylabel("hydropathy")
    ax.set_title(f"{NAME[acc]}: {int(sub.membrane_competent.sum())} of {len(sub)} ksdssp helices are membrane-competent "
                 f"(17 or more residues, mean KD above +0.5)",fontsize=10)
axes[1].set_xlabel("residue")
axes[0].plot([],[],lw=7,color="#2e7d32",label="helix, membrane-competent")
axes[0].plot([],[],lw=7,color="#9aa5ad",label="helix, not membrane-competent")
axes[0].axvspan(0,0,color="#e07b39",alpha=0.30,label="Phobius TM segment")
axes[0].legend(fontsize=7.5,loc="upper right",ncol=3)
fig.suptitle("The seed hypothesis's own test, run with Phenix ksdssp on the AlphaFold models: ftm3 has one membrane-competent helix (38-61), "
             "the 344 aa PF09437 member has five",fontsize=10.5)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0,0,1,0.94]); plt.show()
